options.content:
Each panel gets data that is hard to draw.

Check that no panel crashes. The no data panel shows the panel "No data" view. The invalid and null panels draw only the valid rows. The many points panel draws 2000 markers without a delay.

panels.title: No data
panels.description: The query returns no rows. The panel shows its no data view.

panels.title: Invalid coordinates
panels.description: Rows with latitude 200, longitude 500 and text values. Only Berlin and Paris are valid.

targets.csvContent:
name,lat,lon
Berlin,52.52,13.405
Paris,48.8566,2.3522
Bad lat,200,10
Bad lon,10,500
Text,abc,def

panels.title: Null values
panels.description: Rows with empty lat, lon and value cells. Size and color come from `value`.

panels.title: Many points (2000)
panels.description: 2000 random points around the world. World view.
